domain_owner: existing native_adapter dispatcher; same loaded profile/policy
request_framing: one bare UTF8 JSON per child; stdin EOF
capability_rules: derive from actual supported FIELDS/installed schemas, not roadmap cards
decoder: strict UTF8, duplicate-key/NaN/trailing-data rejection, exact allowed fields
success_wrapper: occ.desktop-stdio-result.v1 with adapter_context + shared native result
error_wrapper: typed error, optional null context before profile load
operation_binding: result.operation equals request.type; namespace/scope checks remain at owner
on_timeout: stop/reap child, bounded pipe cleanup, typed read retry; no stale UI mutation
on_profile_change: PROFILE_CHANGED; re-handshake, new generation; old result discarded
on_close: invalidate generation, cancel child, no widget writes after close
browser_compatibility: legacy argv/wrapper and public dispatch return unchanged; durable.info can be advertised
data_setup: require ready existing backend/store; info before Core/DB init; no desktop schema migration
unsupported_mutations: reject before execution; canonical task/import/job writes outside slice
